author: unshavensmoe
quote: Struggling through with about 20 hours in. Game is very poorly optimised, story is good, it's not worth the hype. Scored lower as a counter to games media corruption, realisticly maybe a 4-5, at the very most 7 if it didn't frame dip so much.

author: unshavensmoe
quote:
graphically a great looking game and the single player campaign this time around was somewhat decent. But BF games are all about the multiplayer, sadly the horrible netcode along with an unacceptable amount of crashing issues makes the game unplayable.
the game is packed with great features like levolution (dynamic evolving warzones) great weapons and vehicles  But this just makes the netcode issues all the more frustrating as its a great game just out of arms reach. if completely fixed my score would easily hit a 9 but the problems are that bad to warrant a 3.
